title: The spend meter cannot see a customer's AWS spend and reports zero as ok
description:
Found 2026-09-19 after the daily rollup finally ran on development (chatticus-26f253). The Lambda works and writes real rows, but the number in them is not real spend.

## Evidence
- Invoked chatticus-development-daily-budget-rollup once. Wrote anthus / 2026-09-18: ce_status=ok, aws_cost_usd=0, combined=0.
- Cost Explorer for the same day, whole account (335163751677): $22.35 unblended. Grouped by tag chatticus:tenant: one group, the untagged bucket ('chatticus:tenant$'), holding all $22.35. Nothing attributes to any tenant.
- Cost allocation tags in the account: chatticus:environment is Inactive; chatticus:tenant and chatticus:component are not registered at all.
- Nothing in infra/lib or python/src applies a chatticus:tenant tag to any resource (grep finds only the reader in cost_explorer.py). BUDGETS.md says summoned Fargate tasks are tagged with tenant_id; no code does that.

## Two separate defects
1. Wrong account. The ceiling exists so a customer is not surprised by their own AWS bill (43e64c). cost_explorer.py builds one boto3 Cost Explorer client in the account the Lambda runs in (Anthus). The runner never assumes a customer role or uses aws_account_id, and infra/customer-role.yml has no ce: permission. For a cross-account organization the meter therefore cannot see any of its spend, ever.
2. Silent false negative. Spend Cost Explorer cannot attribute becomes Decimal('0') with ce_status=ok (runner.py: costs_by_tenant.get(tenant_id, Decimal('0'))). organization_spend treats ok rows as truth, so an unattributed org reads as under its ceiling. The fail-closed design in 6a9e97 covers pending/error days; it does not cover 'ok but empty'.

## Options (needs Ryan)
- For cross-account orgs, follow BUDGETS.md's own rule (one account per deployment, the account boundary does the work, no tags needed): assume the customer role and read the account's total UnblendedCost. Needs ce:GetCostAndUsage added to customer-role.yml (existing customers must update their stack), Cost Explorer enabled in each customer account, and a rollup step that iterates orgs by aws_account_id.
- For Anthus-hosted orgs: apply chatticus:tenant / chatticus:environment tags to the resources, then activate them in the Billing console (a person-step; activation is not retroactive). Shared spend needs an apportionment rule.
- Independently: decide whether an org with a ceiling but no working spend source should read as meter unavailable (paused, fail closed) instead of $0.

## Done when
A real day of spend in an organization's account appears in its rollup row, and an org whose spend cannot be read is not reported as $0 ok. Until then the ceiling must not be cited to customers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan approved: read a customer account's whole spend through its role (no existing customers, so updating the role stack is free) and treat an unreadable meter as unavailable (paused, fail closed). PR #371 implements both for cross-account organizations: the rollup assumes the org's ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole and reads total UnblendedCost; a failed read is ce_status=error with no figure, never zero; error already makes the meter unavailable so an org with a ceiling is refused computer work (new Gherkin covers it). customer-role.yml gains ce:GetCostAndUsage, self-setup requires it, the rollup Lambda may sts:AssumeRole. Guards mutation-checked. STILL OPEN on this card: (1) hosted organizations (in the Anthus account) still use the tag path, which reports an unattributable org as $0 ok, and nothing applies the chatticus:tenant tag; the home org anthus has no ceiling so it is unaffected today, but the same defect applies if it gets one. Needs a decision: apply tags and activate them in Billing (person-step), or give hosted orgs a fail-closed rule. (2) The first real customer-account read is unverified: it needs an organization with the updated role and Cost Explorer enabled in its account. (3) Customer prerequisites are person-steps: enable Cost Explorer (console, ~1 day to populate) and run the current template; the web stack republishes the template on deploy. Machine note: local full behave hit ENOSPC because this Mac's data volume is at 100% (kanbus-router-worktrees 6.8 GB and /private/tmp/kanbus-router-live-r2 1.8 GB are not from this work); affected features (126 scenarios) pass locally and full behave runs in CI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: #371 merged (8185fcf); dev ThinTurn and Web deploys both succeeded. Verified on development: (1) the deployed ChatticusThinTurn template gives the rollup role ce:GetCostAndUsage and sts:AssumeRole on arn:aws:iam::*:role/ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole; (2) the published template at https://dev.chattic.us/provisioning/customer-role.yml now carries the CostExplorerRead statement (ce:GetCostAndUsage); (3) the rollup was invoked again with the new code: 200, no error, anthus row refreshed (hosted tag path unchanged, still ok/0). Note: IAM's endpoint was unreachable from this machine, so (1) was read from CloudFormation, not IAM. NOT verified: a real customer-account read (needs an organization with the updated role plus Cost Explorer enabled in its account). Still open on this card: hosted organizations (tag path reads an unattributable org as $0 ok; needs Ryan's decision between applying and activating tags, or a fail-closed rule for hosted orgs).
